segments.contextAfter: **Bounding Volume Traversals**: You can use the Bounding Volume Traversals mode to highlight areas of your scene that are more expensive to traverse. Xcode color-codes the number of traversals it takes to intersect your acceleration structure on a scale from white (fewer traversals) to dark blue (more traversals). As you move the pointer around the viewport, the inspector (at the bottom left) updates several traversal statistics for the pixel under the pointer, along with the corresponding minimum and maximum values in the viewport.
